tasks.gr12-prescribed-works-comparison-t2: Topic: Grade 12 English HL comparison of prescribed works. Cover drama, novel and poetry comparison, theme development, characterization, setting, conflict and evidence-based interpretation. Ask learners to compare two texts or two characters, identify shared and contrasting themes, link genre-specific techniques to meaning and select evidence that supports comparative claims.
tasks.gr12-unseen-poetry-interpretation-t2: Topic: Grade 12 English HL unseen poetry interpretation. Cover speaker, tone, imagery, diction, structure, line breaks, sound devices and comparison between seen and unseen poems. Ask learners to infer tone, identify imagery, explain form, interpret figurative language and support unseen-poetry responses with concise evidence from the poem.
tasks.gr12-formal-persuasive-writing-t2: Topic: Grade 12 English HL formal and persuasive writing. Cover argumentative and discursive essays, speeches, articles, formal letters and reviews, with focus on register, tone, audience and format. Ask learners to choose suitable formats, identify persuasive techniques, strengthen thesis statements, distinguish tone levels and correct format errors in transactional writing.
tasks.gr12-midyear-exam-preparation-t2: Topic: Grade 12 English HL mid-year exam preparation. Cover Paper 1, Paper 2 and Paper 3 revision, timed writing, literature recall, summary timing, oral continuation and exam strategy. Ask learners to identify suitable revision routines, allocate time across sections, choose effective study methods and respond to common exam-preparation scenarios across all three papers.
